memory_update.text: Add HUBB as a high-priority second-order grid-equipment candidate: utility T&D/substation/transmission products and data-center electrification exposure, not a pure transformer OEM.
Add POWL as a direct switchgear/custom electrical systems candidate with unusually strong backlog evidence and data-center mega-order evidence.
Add WCC as the distributor/logistics layer for electrical, utility and data-center products; relevant where qualified equipment allocation and procurement complexity become chokepoints.
Add NVT as an adjacent electrical protection/enclosure/bus/power-distribution candidate; requires verification of high-voltage versus rack/low-voltage mix.
Add ATKR as a lower-confidence conduit/cable-management second-order candidate; evidence needed to separate data-center/grid demand from broader construction cycle.

Future passes should separately map non-US ADRs/foreign leaders with US trading access, including Siemens Energy, Schneider Electric, Prysmian, Nexans, Hitachi Energy-related exposures, Hyosung Heavy Industries and HD Hyundai Electric.

node: High-voltage transformers, switchgear, cables, and grid-supporting equipment
summary: Expanded the node universe toward second-order and less obvious US-listed exposures: utility/grid components, custom switchgear, electrical distribution/logistics, enclosure/connection systems, and conduit/cable-management suppliers. The working chokepoint remains that AI data-center and broader electrification demand can be gated by qualified electrical equipment availability, utility references, and long procurement cycles. This is research support only, not a trading recommendation.
